claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G lens; no origin/region or purchase history is visible.
Photos show the lens exterior text, but do not clearly confirm absence of scratches/fungus/haze/oil or internal dust.
A lens photo cannot show shutter count; no camera screen/EXIF is shown.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No clear macro inspection of both glass elements is shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: The item shown is a Nikon 50mm 1.8G lens; the witness report does not show any battery/charger, and a lens does not normally include them.

risks.risk: Glass condition issues (scratches, fungus, haze, oil film) that reduce image quality
risks.proof: One clear macro shot of the front and rear elements under strong light at multiple angles (including edges), plus a quick wipe test showing no residue.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown optical condition (worst-case: possible haze/fungus/scratches).

risks.risk: Internal dust or haze not visible in the provided close-ups
risks.proof: A photo through the lens at f/1.8 and f/8 against a bright background (or a short video showing flare/contrast), plus a view of the rear element at an angle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially dusty/unclean internally (worst-case: needs cleaning).

risks.risk: Autofocus/aperture may be faulty or slow (no functional test shown)
risks.proof: Short video on a Nikon body showing AF focus acquisition and aperture actuation (confirming it stops down correctly).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested for AF/aperture (worst-case: AF issues).

risks.risk: Mount/threads/contacts damage or wobble (not shown clearly)
risks.proof: Close-up of the lens mount from straight-on showing contacts/threads, and a clip showing the lens seated firmly with no play.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mount condition unknown (worst-case: minor wobble or contact wear).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (front/rear caps and/or hood) affecting usability and resale
risks.proof: Photo showing all included items laid out (front cap, rear cap, hood if any, and any paperwork/box).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing common accessories (worst-case: no caps/hood).

proof_requests: Send clear macro photos of both front and rear glass elements (including edges) under bright light from multiple angles.
Send a short video test on a Nikon body showing autofocus acquisition and aperture operation.
Send a straight-on close-up of the lens mount (contacts/threads) and a clip showing it seated with no wobble.
List and photograph all included accessories (front cap, rear cap, hood, box/paperwork if any).
If claiming shutter count, provide the camera body screen/EXIF screenshot from which it was taken (or explain how it was determined).
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition; the seller’s condition/origin/shutter-count/battery claims are not verifiable from the provided evidence.
